simple.meaning: מְרִיא (mᵉrîyʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “stall-fed ; often (as noun) a beeve.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 8 times across 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, Isaiah, Ezekiel, Amos, beginning at 2 Samuel 6:13. Its contexts include family, family line, sacrifice, death, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְרִיא (H4806).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְרִיא (mᵉrîyʼ) / H4806 is traced through 2 Samuel 6:13, 1 Kings 1:9, 1 Kings 1:19, 1 Kings 1:25 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;
He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live king Adonijah!’
“What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh.
The wolf will live with the lamb,
You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings,

definitions.full: H4806. meri מְרִיא noun [masculine] fatling, fatlings ; — absolute ׳מ 2Sam 6:13 3 t.; plural absolute מְרִיאִים Isa 1:11 , construct מְרִיאֵי Ezek 39:18 ; suffix מְרִיאֵיכֶם Amos 5:22 ; — fatling: וּמְרִיא וּכְפִיר עֵגֶל Isa 11:6 ; elsewhere only of sacrificial animals, מְרִיאֵיכֶם שֶׁלָם Amos 5:22 (|| מִנְחֹתֵיכֶם עֹלוֺת, ); מְרִיאִים חֵלֶב Isa 1:11 (|| מָּרִים דַּם אֵלִים, עֹלוֺת , etc); בָשָׁן מְרִיאֵי Ezek 39:18 (+ אֵילִים פָרִים, , etc.); also singular collective, וּמְדִיא שׁוֺר וַיִּןבָּח 2Sam 6:13 , so (+ וּבָקָר צאֹן ) 1Kin 1:9 , and (+ צאֹן שׁוֺר, ) 1:19 ; 1:25 .
definitions.rootNote: from 4754 in the sense of grossness , through the idea of domineering (compare 4756 );
